lastRequest: Build a fullstack Flashcard Hub with Express, Prisma database models, Express endpoints, and a React frontend. The application must store decks and cards in the database, allow creating and editing cards via REST APIs, display them on a clean Vercel-style card deck dashboard, and feature mock test quizzes with strict TypeScript safety.

tasks.title: Database Schema & Prisma Setup
tasks.description: Initialize Prisma ORM with SQLite/PostgreSQL, defining Deck, Card, and QuizResult models with correct relations and constraints.

tasks.title: Express Backend & API Implementation
tasks.description: Implement Express server with TypeScript, structured repositories/controllers for Decks, Cards, and QuizResults adhering to REST principles.

tasks.title: Frontend Core Setup & State Management
tasks.description: Set up React with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide icons, and Zustand stores to handle API communication and client state.

tasks.title: Dashboard & Deck/Card Editor Implementation
tasks.description: Build Vercel-style dashboard with search, stats, and complete CRUD forms for decks and cards using React Hook Form and Zod validation.

tasks.title: Interactive Quiz Mode & Results Polish
tasks.description: Implement interactive quiz mode with score tracking, confetti feedback, and results summary using Framer Motion and Canvas Confetti.
